pages.content:
## Hero
JOIN & SAVE — [Join Now] (photo of the storefront and vacuum canopies)

## OUR MISSION
We strive to provide the best car washes and customer service experiences possible. Our formula is simple: making people feel good by delivering an eco-friendly alternative, spotless, and professional car wash every single time. We believe that no matter what you drive, you will feel happier about your car after visiting our car wash!

## SINGLE WASHES
Manager Special (Express Wash) · The Ultimate (Express Wash) · Wheel & Clean (Express Wash) · The Basic (Express Wash) — no prices shown on the homepage.
[Click Here To View Our Monthly Memberships!]

## Location
LOCATED IN PEMBROKE PINES, FLORIDA
OPEN EVERYDAY 8:00 am - 8:00 pm
(Google Map)

## OUR IMPACT
My Eco Wash is a business that relies on water, which is a precious resource. By washing your vehicle at My Eco Wash, you help us conserve water through our water-saving technology. We are committed to providing you with the best experience through state-of-the-art equipment, products, and service. [Learn More]

1 — STATE-OF-THE-ART WATER RECLAIM SYSTEM: At My Eco Wash, we have the capacity to store over 120,000 liters of reclaimed water at any one point in time!
2 — ECO-FRIENDLY BIODEGRADABLE SOAPS AND DETERGENTS.: Did you know that washing your car at home can introduce non-biodegradable soaps, oils, brake dust, and other pollutants into our streams, rivers, lakes, and oceans? At My Eco Wash, we only use premium soaps and chemicals.
3 — FUNDRAISING & OUR COMMUNITY: Our commitment extends beyond the car wash tunnel. We actively participate in our local community through various programs and events. Part of being a conscious neighbor is looking for ways to improve and provide a brighter future for our team members, community, and the world we live in.

## STAY CONNECTED
Sign up with your email address to receive news, updates, and special promotions. (First Name, Last Name, Email Address, SIGN UP) We respect your privacy.

This Monthly Package Includes: Pre-Soak; Soft Cloth Automatic Wash; Wheel Cleaner; Hot Wax & Shine; Triple Foam Polish; Spot Free Rinse; Jet Dry; Black Magic Tire Shine; Step 1 & 2 Wheel Cleaner; Rain – X. [Subscribe]

### Unlimited Eco Wash Club - Wheel & Clean — $24.99 every month
This Monthly Package Includes: Pre-Soak; Soft Cloth Automatic Wash; Under Body Rinse; Triple Foam Polish; Spot Free Rinse; Jet Dry; Step 1 & 2 Wheel Cleaner. [Subscribe]

## Wash your vehicle once a day for one low monthly fee!
If you like a clean car and want to wash it once a day, once a week, or as often as you can, all for one low price, then the Unlimited Eco Wash Club is for you! Simply select the desired wash package, and your credit card will be charged a flat monthly fee.

## How it works
The Unlimited Eco Wash Club is vehicle-specific and can only be associated with one vehicle. A radio frequency identification decal ("RFID") wirelessly approves your Unlimited Eco Wash Club each time you visit us at My Eco Wash. The RFID must be placed on your vehicle's windscreen. If you purchase a new vehicle, simply contact us to update your vehicle profile and have a new RFID installed.

## How often can I wash?
You may wash your vehicle once every 24 hours during the month. My Eco Wash will only be closed on specified public holidays and during hurricanes. Please refer to our website for further details.

## How are you charged each month?
My Eco Wash charges your credit card month-to-month. There are no long-term commitments or hidden cancellation charges. In the event that you would like to cancel your membership, My Eco Wash must receive written notice 14 days before your next billing date. No refunds or credits will be given for partial periods; however, you may continue to use your membership until your expiry date.

## What happens next?
After receipt of this form and your first initial payment is made, please visit us at My Eco Wash to place your RFID sticker onto your vehicle's windscreen. For more information, please call or visit us, and our staff will be very happy to assist you.

## Terms & Conditions
Read Our Unlimited Eco Wash Club Terms & Conditions Here. (link target not visible)

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content:
# Frequently Asked Questions

### HOW DO I SIGN UP FOR THE UNLIMITED ECO WASH CLUB?
The Unlimited Eco Wash Club is available for purchase online, at every My Eco Wash location through our automated pay kiosk, or by speaking with our team! Choose From Our Unlimited Eco Wash Club Packages: [Unlimited Eco Wash Club]

### DOES ANY OF THE WATER USED IN THE CAR WASH GET RECYCLED?
Throughout the entire car wash process at My Eco Wash, we use the most advanced water reclamation technology and equipment (Reverse Osmosis Filtration Systems).

### HOW DOES THE UNLIMITED ECO WASH CLUB WORK?
Our memberships allow you to wash up to once per day at any My Eco Wash location. You will receive an RFID sticker that will be placed on the inside of your front windshield. Our system will automatically scan your decal when you drive up to our pay kiosk area. This will allow you to enter the car wash without any further action required. On the date your purchase is confirmed, your membership will renew automatically every month on that date.

### HOW DO I CANCEL MY UNLIMITED ECO WASH CLUB MEMBERSHIP?
Membership plans can be canceled at any time up to 14 days before your monthly recharge date. Please ask to fill out a cancellation form at the store or give us a call. Be sure to continue washing through the end of your last paid month.

### WHAT KIND OF SOAPS AND WAXES DO YOU USE?
All of our cleansers, soaps, and waxes are 100% biodegradable. They are carefully tested to ensure they are safe for both your vehicle and the environment. We have invested in state-of-the-art chemical mixing technology that delivers precise amounts of crystal-clear water and gentle, effective cleansers, soaps, and waxes.

### IS YOUR CAR WASH SAFE FOR MY VEHICLE?
Our car washes are designed to leave your vehicle clean, shiny, and dry, with no damage. However, we cannot be responsible for the following items: Antennas (we recommend lowering/removing before washing). Rearview mirrors (we recommend folding them in before washing). Rear hitch/spare tire (if not removed, the back of your vehicle will not be cleaned). Windshield wipers (ensure they are off before washing). Pre-existing damage to any exterior part/surface (known/unknown). Non-factory or dealer-installed equipment. Moldings/chrome/decals/pin striping. Bug shields and guards. Convertible soft tops. Damaged/oxidations on paint or clear coat. Anything on vehicles 1 year or older.

### ARE THERE ANY KINDS OF VEHICLES THAT CANNOT BE WASHED?
Yes, for your safety, we cannot wash vehicles with the following items: Vehicles with excessive mud. Vehicles taller than 7 feet. Dual-wheel trucks. Tires wider than 12 inches. Truck beds with debris, oil, or fuel tanks. Vehicles with less than 4 inches of ground clearance. Vehicles with excessive body damage or loose parts. No trailers or vehicles longer than 21 feet.

### HOW LONG CAN I USE THE VACUUMS?
Our vacuums are free to use with the purchase of any wash or membership plan and can be used as long as needed. During busy times, we ask that you please limit your vacuum use to 10 minutes so that others may utilize our free services.
